messages.msgid: You sense something emitting electricity here.
translations: 你感觉这里有东西在放电。

messages.msgid: You sense an otherworldy danger here.
translations: 你感觉到这里有一种异界的危险。
温彻斯特 M70 步枪
改进型李-恩菲尔德步枪
柯尔特 M1861 海军型 左轮手枪
勃朗宁大威力 .40 S&W 手枪
温彻斯特 M37 .410 霰弹枪
柯尔特 M1860 陆军型 左轮手枪
莫辛纳甘 战斗步枪

messages.msgid: Killing enemies allows you to level up, unlocking powerful and fun perks for your character.  Just after game start a configuration menu should open to let you enable the mod.
translations: 杀死敌人可以让你升级，为你的角色解锁强大而有趣的技能。游戏开始后会打开一个配置菜单，让你启用该模组。

messages.msgid: Direct access to the perk menu.
Have you been working out?  +1 Strength.
You HAVE been working out.  +2 Strength.
translations: 你一直在锻炼自己，力量+2。

messages.msgid: Have you been doing cardio?  +1 Dexterity.
translations: 你一直在做有氧运动吗？敏捷 +1。

messages.msgid: You HAVE been doing cardio.  +2 Dexterity.
translations: 你一直保持充分的有氧运动，敏捷+2。

messages.msgid: Have you been staring out into the middle distance?  +1 Perception.
translations: 你是不是一直在顶着远方？感知 +1。

messages.msgid: You HAVE been staring out into the middle distance.  +2 Perception.
You have an instinctive sense for the uncanny and unearthy.  Activate this perk to close your eyes and become aware of nearby Nether creatures.
translations: 你对不可思议和超凡之物有一种本能的感觉。激活此技能可以让你闭上眼睛并意识到附近的异界生物。

messages.msgid: Your rippling muscles enable you to split the skulls of your enemies.  +5% to Lifting, Grip, and Manipulator limb scores.
translations: 你隆起的肌肉让你能轻易劈开敌人的头颅。举重、抓握、操控肢体能力皆提升5%。

messages.msgid: Your movements bring to mind a multitude of cat-based metaphors.  +5% to Balance, Footing, and Reaction limb scores.
translations: 你的动作让人联想到一系列猫科动物般的比喻。平衡、下肢与反应能力提升5%。

messages.msgid: Your sharp gazes misses little.  +25% to Vision and Night Vision limb scores.
translations: 你的锐利目光几乎不会遗漏任何细节。视觉和夜视能力 + 25%

messages.msgid: Never leave home without it!  You have a secret pocket no one knows about that can easily store a weapon.
translations: 有它谁还忘带武器！你现在有个可以存放一件武器的秘密口袋。

messages.msgid: You're like a walking tank!  Take 5% less damage from all sources.
translations: 你简直是是人形坦克！所有来源的伤害减免 5%。

messages.msgid: All that hauling has paid off.  You can carry 10kg of additional items.
translations: 多搬多得。你现在可以多带 10kg 的物品。

messages.msgid: Every day in the apocalypse is just like the beach.  You are more comfortable in cold and warm weather.
translations: 别人可能是大灾变，对你来说就像是在度假。你对寒冷或炎热的天气的忍耐能力更强。

messages.msgid: Your time exercising has gotten you used to being drenched in your own sweat.  Being wet doesn't bother you as much anymore.
translations: 你曾经锻炼的时光，让你已经习惯浑身湿透大汗淋漓的感觉。湿身不再让你心情变差。

messages.msgid: You're very good at the follow-through when your enemies are reeling.  When in melee combat with an enemy that is dazed or stunned, you do +33% extra bash damage.
translations: 当你的敌人摇摇欲坠时，你很擅长跟进。当你与晕眩或晕眩的敌人进行近战时，你会额外造成33%的重击伤害。

messages.msgid: You've taken so many blows to the head you've lost count.  You've got additional skull armor.
translations: 你头上挨了太多下，你已经数不清了！你现在很头铁，获得额外的头部护甲。

messages.msgid: You've dealt enough blows that your hands have callused, and your knifehand strikes are sharp enough to draw blood.
translations: 你一直在徒手攻击，你的手已经长满了老茧。现在你的刀手锋利得足以让人见血。

messages.msgid: You've dealt enough blows that your hands have callused, and your hammerfist strikes are as strong as a real hammer.
translations: 你一直在徒手攻击，你的手已经长满了老茧。现在你的拳头硬得像一柄真正的锤子。

messages.msgid: You've dealt enough blows that your hands have callused, your spearhand strikes can pierce armor, and your grip can turn bolts barehanded.
translations: 你一直在徒手攻击，你的手已经长满了老茧。现在你的手指刺戳甚至可以穿透护甲，并且可以徒手拧动螺栓。

messages.msgid: Practicing with handguns has improved your draw speed with pretty much everything.  Retrieve objects 25% faster from containers.
translations: 长久的拔枪练习几乎让你拿取任何东西的速度都变快了。从包里取东西的速度加快 25%。

messages.msgid: Oh, they're not getting away with THAT.  You do +15% damage for two turns after you're hit.
translations: 他们逃不掉的！被击中后两回合内造成伤害+15%。

messages.msgid: You inspire your allies to protect you when you're seriously injured.  If attacked when your head or torso health are at 50% or lower, all allies within 15 meters will take 20% reduced damage for one minute.  This effect can only trigger once every five minutes.
translations:
你激励你的盟友在你受重伤时保护你。如果你的头部或躯干生命值在50%或更低时受到攻击，15米内的所有盟友受到的伤害将减少20%，持续一分钟。
此效果每五分钟只能触发一次。

messages.msgid: You've gotten pretty good at sneaking up on people.  When you have no allies within 20 squares, enemies' vision detection range is reduced by 15%.
translations: 你已经很擅长偷偷接近别人了。当你在20距离内没有盟友时，敌人的视觉探测范围降低15%。

messages.msgid: You can really put it away.  You eat food 10% faster and can eat 33% more food at a time.
translations: 你真是个大胃王。你可以让食物消失得更快，进食速度提升10%，并且一次能多吃33%的食物。

messages.msgid: At some point you got really good at falling off rooftops.  Take 40% less fall damage.
translations: 虽然用处不算大，但你很擅长从屋顶往下跳，并尽可能保持稳定。你受到的跌落伤害减少 40%。

messages.msgid:
When you have to you can wipe the blood off your chin, grit your teeth, and get it done.  Use to reduce your pain by 30 or half (whichever is greater) for 3 minutes.

The cooldown on this perk scales based on your pain at the time you used it.
translations:
当你需要的时候，你可以擦去下巴上的血迹，咬紧牙关，完成任务。用它来减轻30或一半的疼痛（以较大者为准），持续3分钟。

这个技能的冷却时间取决于你使用它时的痛苦程度。

messages.msgid: Careful aim allows you to take down game with little tissue damage.  Enemies you kill tend to stay intact.
translations: 你可以通过仔细瞄准，恰到好处地击杀你的猎物。你杀死的生物的尸体往往会保持完整。

messages.msgid: For whatever reason you seem to always make a real mess of things.  Enemies you kill tend to explode into a mess of viscera.
translations: 没什么特别的原因，仅仅是你喜欢大开杀戒，并且将你的敌人彻底撕裂罢了。死在你手下的生物往往只会得到五脏六腑碎裂一地的下场。

messages.msgid: You used to annoy your friends before the Cataclysm by always being *exactly* on time and you've maintained that characteristic to this day.  You always know what time it is and can set alarms even without a watch or a phone.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你总是“完全”准时，这让你的朋友很恼火，直到今天你还保持着这个特点。你总是知道当前的时间，即使没有手表或手机也能设置闹钟。

messages.msgid: You have a persistent sense of how to move around in sharp and rough terrain.  You'll never accidently snag or cut yourself on protrusions from the ground.
translations: 你对如何在陡峭崎岖的地形中移动有着持久的感知力。你永远不会意外被地面的突出物勾住或割伤。

messages.msgid: You've always loved reading, especially before you fall asleep, and have gotten very good at tearing through books as a way to wind down.  You read books 50% faster, but only when you read them between 8 p.m. and 1 a.m.
translations:
你一直都很喜欢阅读，尤其是在睡觉前，你会把书翻来翻去作为一种放松的方式。

你的阅读速度提高了50%，但只有当你在晚上8点到凌晨1点之间阅读时生效。

messages.msgid: Ever since the apocalypse you get a funny feeling during storms and have trouble trusting small appliances.  You usually have a pretty good idea where they are though.
translations: 自从世界末日以来，你在暴风雨中会感到不适，并且很难信任电器。不过，你通常对带电物体的位置心中有数。

messages.msgid: You can't touch a door without zapping yourself.  Whenever there is a shocker or a robot within 15 squares, or you are outside during a storm, you gain 500J of bionic power per second and your melee attacks will do a small amount of extra electrical damage.
translations: 你开门总免不了电到自己。当你15格内有放电类生物或机器类单位的时候，或者你在暴风雨期间呆在室外的时候，你每秒获得500J生化能量并且你的近战攻击会造成少量额外电属性伤害。

messages.msgid: You've not been the same since the apocalypse, almost everything makes you jump.  You are just a bit quicker to act though.
translations: 大灾变后几乎所有的东西都让你吓一跳。你的行动速度更快了些。

messages.msgid: You get knocked down, but you get up again.  There is a 75% chance when you are downed that you will stand up again immediately.
translations:
你被击倒了，但你又站起来了。

当你倒下的时候，有75%的几率你会立刻站起来。

messages.msgid: You've always been able to fall asleep within a few minutes of closing your eyes, no matter what else is going on around you.  You have a much easier time falling asleep.
translations: 无论你周围发生了什么，你总是能够在闭上眼睛的几分钟内入睡。你很容易入睡。

messages.msgid: That health, wealth, and wisdom is coming any day now.  When you wake up between 4 and 7 a.m., you gain a mood boost for that morning.
translations: “健康、财富与智慧终会降临”—— 当你在凌晨 4 点至 7 点间醒来时，晨间将获得情绪提升效果。

messages.msgid: Run without rhythm.  After a short wind-up period, you gain 5 effective dodge and +1 bonus dodge attempt as long as you keep running.
translations: 没有节奏地跑。在短暂的修整后，只要你继续奔跑，你将获得5点有效闪避和+1次额外闪避尝试。

messages.msgid: No work, no social obligations, lots of time to focus on your hobbies.  You feel like you've been picking up skills faster recently.
translations: 远离工作束缚与社交义务，你拥有大把时光投入癖好。近来你发觉技能掌握速度显著提升。

messages.msgid: Hey, that's against the Geneva Convention!  When not wielding a weapon, or object that could be used as an improvised weapon, you take -25% reduced damage.
translations: 嘿，这违反日内瓦公约！当你未持武器或可作临时武器的物品时，所受伤害降低 25%。

messages.msgid: Even with no one around you feel obligated to clean up the streets.  You find full cans of soda in the weirdest places.
translations: 即使周围没有活人，你也会觉得有义务清理街道。你会在最奇怪的地方找到整罐的、完好没开的汽水。

messages.msgid: As if the apocalypse itself wasn't enough, you are constantly looking for some trouble.  Zombies will sometimes appear out of nowhere to attack you.  Fortunately, they always appear at a good distance from you.  Activate to toggle.
translations: 大灾变？太弱了！你尝试给自己加点难度，丧尸会突然凭空出现并攻击你，好消息是他们通常离你有一段距离。（可切换激活）

messages.msgid: You do not drink…wine.  You are immune to the negative consequences of drinking blood, such as parasitic infection.
translations: 你从不喝……酒。你对饮用血液造成的负面效果免疫，比如寄生虫感染。

messages.msgid: Drinking blood makes you feel really good.  REALLY good.  So good that all your aches and pains just seem to fade away.  Every time you drink blood, you heal a bit of damage and lose a bit of pain.
translations: 喝血会让你感觉很好。非常好。好到你所有的疼痛似乎都消失了。每喝一次血，你就治愈一点伤害，减少一点痛苦。

messages.msgid: You spent several years on the high sea and now your muscles visibly swell and clench when you eat raw spinach.
translations: 你已经在公海上航行了许多年，你一吃生菠菜，你身上的肌肉就会肉眼可见的鼓起和紧绷。

messages.msgid: You've been dissecting critters since high school.  Last night a voice gave you an idea for how to bring them back to life.  Activate the perk to gain insight into the nature of life itself!
translations: 你从高中就开始解剖动物了。昨晚，一个声音给了你一个如何让它们复活的想法。激活额外变异，深入了解生命的本质！

messages.msgid: You've always felt like someone was looking out for you upstairs.  When you are attacked there is a 5% chance the attack will deal no damage.
translations: 你总感觉有人在冥冥中照顾你。你受到的攻击有 5% 的概率不造成伤害。

messages.msgid: You have a habit of always ducking at the right time.  You have a 5% chance to dodge any incoming attack.
translations: 面对突发情况你总是躲得很及时。你有 5% 的概率闪躲掉任何冲你来的攻击。

messages.msgid: You always ate your carrots, that good eyesight is paying off.  You can use ranged weapons effectively up to 4 more tiles away.
translations: 你总是吃胡萝卜，你的好视力得到了回报。你可以在4个贴图之外有效地使用远程武器。

messages.msgid: It's called "First Aid", right, so obviously it's better the faster you apply it.  Your bandages are 50% better at stopping bleeding, but only if you apply them within 2 minutes of taking damage.
translations: 这叫“急救”，对吧？所以很明显，越早越好。你使用绷带止血的效率提高50%，但仅限于你受到伤害的2分钟以内。

messages.msgid: Your Nana told you about the evil eye and how to protect yourself when you were a small child.  You don't remember her telling you the evil eye was giant, disembodied, and on fire, but some of the things she taught you work all the same.  You are immune to the Tainted Mind effect as long as you're wearing a holy symbol necklace, and can use some salt to remove it if you do acquire it.
translations: 当你还是个孩子的时候，你的奶奶告诉过你邪恶的眼睛以及如何保护自己。你不记得她告诉你那只邪恶的眼睛是巨大的、没有实体的、着火了，但她教给你的一些东西仍然有效。只要你戴着一条象征神圣的项链，你就不会受到污染心灵的影响，如果你真的沾染诅咒，可以用一些盐来去除它。

messages.msgid: You have learned to cast spells in a way that is much quicker, but also more wasteful.  -95% cast time, +100% cast cost.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
你已经学会了以一种更快的方式施法，但也更浪费。

-95%施法时间，+100%施法消耗。可以通过激活此特性来开启或关闭，对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You have learned to cast spells that affects a larger area.  +100% area of effect, +50% cast cost.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
你已经学会施放影响更大范围的法术。

+100%影响范围，+50%施法消耗。可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭，对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You have learned to cast spells from a longer distance.  +100% reach, +50% cast cost.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
你已经学会了在更远的距离施法。
+100%射程，+50%施法消耗可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭。对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You have learned to cast spells quietly.  -100% noise, +20% cast cost, ignores mouth encumbrance.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
你已经学会悄悄地施法了。
-100%噪音，+20%施法消耗，忽略嘴部累赘。可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭。对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You have learned to cast spells without moving.  +20% cast cost, ignores arm, leg, and hand encumbrance.  Can cast spells while holding items.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
你已经学会了不动就施法。
+20%施法消耗，忽略手臂、腿和手的累赘。持有物品时可以施法。可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭。对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You take your time when casting spells in order to get it right.  +200% cast time, -5 difficulty.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.
translations:
当你施法的时候，你要花点时间，以便正确施法。
+200%施法时间，-5难度。可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭。

messages.msgid: You can cast your spells more efficiently at the cost of a more difficult cast.  *75% casting cost, +5 difficulty.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.
translations: 以更高的施法难度为代价，换取更高效的施法。*施法消耗降为75%，难度+5。可激活此特性进行开关。

messages.msgid: Casting spells comes more naturally for you.  You don't have to think as much when casting.  Focus no longer affects casting, +20% cast cost.  Can be toggled on or of by activating this trait.  Only affects spells that are affected by focus.  Does not work on spells that consumes runes.
translations:
施法对你来说更自然。施法的时候你不需要考虑那么多。
专注不再影响施法，施法消耗+20%。可以通过激活这个特性来开启或关闭，只影响受专注影响的法术，对消耗符文的法术无效。

messages.msgid: You really like to do stuff with your own hands.  +10% for crafting speed.
translations: 你很喜欢自己亲手做点东西。制造速度 +10%。

messages.msgid: Smoking is bad, but damn it's badass.  You deal more damage and shoot more accurately when you smoke.
translations: 吸烟真的不好，但你打枪时还是习惯叼一支。当你吸烟时，你瞄得更准，造成更多伤害。

messages.msgid: The way you take care of the enemies is commendable, so much so that someone or something seems to praise your ways of fighting.  For every kills you have made, a praise may be given in the message log.
translations: 你处理敌人的方式利索到似乎有某个人或者某种东西开始在暗中夸奖你的战斗方式。你每次击杀敌人，信息记录里面都可能出现一句赞扬。

messages.msgid: After some time surviving in the apocalypse, you realized that you don't have to fight fair in melee combat.  Now you can hit below the belt on most humanoid monsters.
translations: 在末世中生存一段时间后，你意识到近身搏斗不必恪守公平。如今你能对大多数类人生物怪物使出下三滥的攻击（攻击腰带以下部位）。

messages.msgid: You've always had a passion for people, and a deep understanding of their thoughts and feelings.  Now that almost everyone's dead that has to extend to other things too!  When you kill a creature gain some of its abilities temporarily.
translations: 你总是对人们充满热情，并且深刻理解他们的想法和感受。现在几乎每个人都死了，这也必须扩展到其他事情上！当你杀死一个生物时，你会暂时获得它的一些能力。

messages.msgid: You've always been a bit of a bull in a china shop; people used to call you heavy handed but now they aren't saying much at all.  You deal extra damage based on how protective your right arm is.
translations:
你总是有点像头在瓷器店里的公牛，以前大家都说你是总是爱下铁手，现在他们都闭嘴了。

根据你右臂的防护水平造成额外的伤害。

messages.msgid: People always used to tell you that you should eat more.  It seems you needed their reminders because you can see your bones at this point.  You have skeletal armor.
translations: 人们总是告诉你应该多吃点，他们说得还挺对，因为你现在就可以直接看到自己的骨头。你的身体拥有骨骼铠甲。

messages.msgid: You're so used to squeezing all your meals into a short time that your body has adapted to it.  You gain 2.5 times as many calories and vitamins from any meals eaten between noon and 6 p.m., but 0 calories and vitamins for any meals eaten outside that time period.
translations: 你已经习惯了在短时间内扫完所有饭菜以至于你的身体都适应了这种做法。 从中午到下午 6 点之间吃的任何一餐，你都能获得 2.5 倍的卡路里和维生素，但在这段时间之外吃的任何一餐，卡路里和维生素都为零。

messages.msgid: You've always had something to say about ripping apart things with chainsaws.  You can swing powered blades faster.
translations: 你对用链锯撕裂物体总有独到见解。如今，你能以更快速度挥舞动力刃具。

messages.msgid: You've always had a bit of a fondness for the older firearms.  Post apocalypse, this has translated into a damage boost when using WWII and older weapons.
translations: 你一直都偏爱老式枪支。大灾变之后，这些二战或更老的枪械也能投入战斗焕发第二春。提升你使用老式武器的伤害。

messages.msgid: Before Cataclysm, you always used dice to determine the damage in the game.  Now, the power of fate allows you to use dice to deal additional mysterious damage.  Throwing dice using a sling or similar weapon deals additional damage, which depends on the number of sides of the dice.
translations: 在大灾变发生之前，你总是使用骰子来在游戏中决定伤害；现在，命运的力量使你可以使用骰子造成神秘的额外伤害。使用投石索或者其他类似的武器投掷骰子会造成额外的伤害，伤害的数值取决于骰子的面数。

messages.msgid: You've always been greatly affected by the phases of the moon.  During a full moon, you gain a +3 bonus to all stats.  During a waxing moon, you gain a +1 bonus to all stats, and during a new moon, you suffer a -2 penalty to all stats.
translations: 你总是深受月相的影响。满月时，你的所有属性获得+3加值。在满月期间，你的所有属性获得+1加值，在新月期间，你的所有属性受到-2惩罚。

messages.msgid: Far from being terrified or even unnerved by the creatures of the Nether, their presence fills you with atavistic killing fury.  You do +35% melee damage when in melee combat with Nether beings and take 15% less damage from all sources, but if you attack any other target when there is a Nether-beast to slay, you suffer a large penalty to your accuracy.
translations: 异界的生物不但不会让你感到恐惧或不安，反而会让你充满原始的杀戮狂热。 与异界生物近战时，你的近战伤害+35%，受到的所有伤害减少15%，但如果你在周围还有异界畜生没杀完的时候攻击其他目标，你的攻击精度和闪避率会受到很大影响。

messages.msgid: Darkness is your ally.  Others have merely adopted the dark, but you were born in it, molded by it.  You gain +2 Perception and +1 Intelligence at night, and have a much easier time sleeping during the day.  However, you also suffer -2 Perception when outdoors during the day and have a harder time sleeping at night.
translations: 黑暗是你的盟友。他人不过是接纳了黑暗，而你生于其中，由其塑造。夜晚时你获得 + 2 感知和 + 1 智力，且在白天更容易入睡。然而，白天在户外时你的感知会 - 2，夜间也更难入眠。

messages.msgid: People talk about getting a high from fasting and for you that's true on a more visceral level.  You gain bonuses to all stats that scale with how hungry, thirsty, and tired you are.
translations: 人们谈论从禁食中获得快感，对你来说这是发自内心的真实感受。你可以根据你的饥饿、口渴和疲倦程度获得所有属性的加成。

messages.msgid: Your blood has always been thicker than most, making you lose less of it when bleeding.
translations: 你的血液比大多数人更浓，使得你流血时流失更少。

messages.msgid: People often say that they feel safer when they sleep, but in your case you are literally safer when asleep.  As long as you sleep, most attacks won't injure you.
translations: 人们常说他们睡觉时会感到更安全，但对你而言只有睡着了才是真的安全。当你睡觉时，大多数攻击不会伤到你。

messages.msgid: You hate the feeling of your blood leaking so much that it empowers you.  Deal more melee damage the more you are bleeding.
translations: 你对自己血液流出的感觉十分厌恶，这种厌恶赋予了你力量。你流血越严重，你造成的近战伤害就越多。

messages.msgid: You know how to leverage your allies' presence when talking with others, granting you a small boost to lying, persuading and intimidating for each nearby ally.
translations: 你懂得在与人交谈时借势利用盟友的存在 —— 每有一位近旁的盟友，便能为你的谎言说服、劝诱及威慑能力带来小幅加成。

messages.msgid: Poisons tend to make you feel numb.  When poisoned, feel 80% less pain.
translations: 毒素往往会让您感到麻木。当你中毒的时候，减少80%疼痛。

messages.msgid: After being stolen the things you held in your hands countless times, your grip became strong enough to keep anything in your hands as long as you will it.  Activate to toggle the ability to drop your held item.
translations: 在无数次被偷走手中的东西后，你的握力变得足够强大，只要你愿意，任何东西都能牢牢握在手中。 激活后可切换放下所持物品的功能。

messages.msgid: You somehow learned to focus on an item to make it emit radiation forever.  You still have trouble understanding how this could ever be useful, but maybe you might find a use for it.  Activate to use.
translations: 你不知怎么的学会了通过对一个物品施加专注来让它永久产生辐射。你仍然难以理解这能有什么用，但也许你会找到它的用处。激活以使用。

messages.msgid: You love the rush of taking different drugs at once, and now this rush is much more impactful than before.  You gain +3 speed for each recreational or combat-enhancing drug currently affecting you.
translations: 你沉溺于服用不同药物带来的刺激感，而现在这种刺激感比以前更强烈了。每种正在生效的娱乐性或战斗增强的药物都能为你带来+3的速度加成。

messages.msgid: You cannot forget anything at all, ever.  This grants you the ability to memorize books for you to read in your head later and makes you able to store mental images so detailled it's almost as if you were taking pictures with your mind.
translations: 你永远不会遗忘任何事情。这赋予你将书籍铭记于心的能力，以便日后在脑海中翻阅；你还能在脑中存储极为细致的画面，仿佛在用思维拍照一般。

messages.msgid: Your blood might not be able to make weapons, but it still can make anything coated with sturdier but unable to be repaired.  Activate to use.
translations: 你的血液也许并不能用来制造武器，不过任何被你的血涂覆的物品将转变为近战耐用但不能被维修的状态。激活以使用。

messages.msgid: Exposure to portal storms and related phenomena causes your body change along predictable lines.  When out in a portal storm without any protection, you periodically have a chance to mutate.
translations: 暴露于空间风暴和相关现象会导致你的身体沿着可预测的路线变化。在没有任何保护的空间风暴中，你有机会周期性的变异。

messages.msgid: You always knew nothing can beat the good old six shooters.  You have a minor bonus using revolvers.
translations: 你始终坚信没有什么能胜过经典的六发左轮。使用左轮手枪时可获得小幅加成。

messages.msgid: You always appreciated the size of this little fella named "Dot Two Two Long Rifle", but they laughed at you.  Not anymore!  You found that the size of a bullet that small is perfect to hit into little spots between armor or narrow places.  .22 weapons have additional armor penetration and quadrupled chance to hit a weakpoint.
translations: 你始终偏爱那把名为 “点二二长步枪” 的小家伙，尽管曾遭人嗤笑。但今非昔比！你发现如此微小的子弹，正适合命中盔甲缝隙或狭窄死角。使用.22 口径武器时，额外获得穿甲能力，且弱点命中率提升至四倍。

messages.msgid: Wearing this will protect you from the Evil Eye.
translations: 戴上这个可以保护你不受邪眼的伤害。

messages.msgid: Throw some salt over your shoulder.
This is really going to hurt.  Applied to targets of the Bellringer perk.
translations: 这会很痛苦。适用于敲钟人能力的目标。

messages.msgid: You've dealt so many blows your hands are rough with calluses.  The bottoms of your hand can deal blows hard enough to hammer or finely crush objects.
translations: 你徒手干掉了不少家伙，你的手已经长满了老茧。你的手掌底部足以施展猛烈的打击，用来攻击或精工锤打物品。

messages.msgid: You definitely won't attract the worm.  +5 effective dodge, +1 dodge attempt.
translations: 你绝对不招虫子。+5 有效闪避，+1 闪避次数。

messages.msgid: You are really feeling for the last zombie you killed.  That must have been really hard for it to die again.  Though you aren't really feeling pain right now.
translations: 你与你击杀的上一只丧尸感同身受。再死一次肯定不好受吧。尽管你现在并没有真正感到疼痛。

messages.msgid: You feel a bit hungry for brains.
translations: 你感受到对于新鲜脑子的渴望。
现在脑子对你来说好像没那么诱人了。

messages.msgid: You are really feeling for the last animal you killed.  Reminds you of that scene in the movie where they kill the pet, really sad stuff.  Though you are feeling ready to learn to fight right now.
translations: 你与你击杀的上一只动物感同身受。让你想起电影里杀死宠物的场景，令人悲伤。同时，你感觉自己准备好了像动物一样战斗。

messages.msgid: You are ready for a fight.
translations: 你的狩猎本能让你准备好投入到战斗中了。
动物般的狩猎本能渐渐消退...

messages.msgid: You are really feeling for the last demon you killed.  Must be hard to die when you don't truly exist.  Though you are feeling rejuvenated.
translations: 你与你击杀的上一只异界生物感同身受。作为不被世人所熟知的种族，死亡也不好受吧。你感觉自己的身体充满复生的能量。

messages.msgid: You feel your wounds begin to seal.
translations: 你感觉你的再生能力加强了。
你的再生速度回到了正常水平。

messages.msgid: You are really feeling for the last mushroom you killed.  You always hated mushrooms on food, too earthy for your taste.  Though you feel like your illness is gone.
translations: 你与你击杀的上一只真菌体感同身受。你总是讨厌食物中的蘑菇，它们对你的口味来说太土了。同时，你感觉到自己体内的疾病正在消失。

messages.msgid: You feel like something eats all the sickness inside you.
translations: 你感觉体内的疾病似乎被吞噬了。

messages.msgid: You are really feeling for the last bug you killed.  You always hated squishing bugs, what did they ever do to you.  Though you feel like your skin has hardened.
translations: 你与你击杀的上一只昆虫感同身受。就像你总是讨厌压扁无辜的虫子。同时，你感觉你的皮肤开始硬化。

messages.msgid: You can remember with perfect detail everything you've ever lived, even allowing you to read books and play games by remembering them.
translations: 你可以回忆起有关你经历过的一切的完美的细节 ，使你甚至能通过回忆读书和玩游戏。

messages.msgid: A stitched together monstrosity of meat and bone, with limbs as wide as trash cans.  This one is still sleeping.  It would require a master's touch to bring it to life.
translations: 一直由血肉和白骨缝合在一起的怪物，四肢像垃圾桶一样粗。它还在沉睡，等待谁来让它重获生命。

messages.msgid: A secret pocket no one knows about that can easily store a weapon.
translations: 一个无人知晓的秘密口袋，可以轻松存放一件武器。

messages.msgid: Under the clear light of the full moon, you have unlocked your greatest potential.
translations: 在满月的清辉下，你释放了自己最大的潜力。

messages.msgid: The silver light of the waxing moon enhances your prowess.
translations: 上弦月的银光增强了你的能力。

messages.msgid: In the dark of the moon, you feel your vital essence weaken.
translations: 在黯淡的月光中，你感到你的生命本质变弱了。
汤普森 M1928A1 冲锋枪
施迈瑟 MP40 冲锋枪
斯登 Mk II 冲锋枪
勃朗宁大威力 9x19mm 手枪

messages.msgid: You've dealt so many blows your hands are rough with calluses.  The edge of your hand is sharp enough to cut paper.
translations: 你徒手干掉了不少家伙，你的手已经长满了老茧。你的手掌边缘锋利得吹毛可断。

messages.msgid: You've dealt so many blows your hands are rough with calluses.  The tips of your fingers can pinch firmly enough to pry nails or turn small bolts.
translations: 你徒手干掉了不少家伙，你的手已经长满了老茧。你的手指尖足够可以掀开钉子或拧动螺栓。

messages.msgid: You gain the strength of a sailor.
translations: 你像大力水手那样从菠菜里获得力量。

messages.msgid: You have the strength of a sailor!
translations: 你现在像大力水手一样强壮！

messages.msgid: You are filled with a furious rage that is sending your swings wide.
translations: 你被极度的愤怒填满以至于攻击失准。

messages.msgid: Crimson clouds your vision as a rage fills you at the presence of these hell-spawn.  You must slay them!  It is they who should feel the sting of your blade, not the rabble!
translations: 当地狱造物现身时，猩红狂怒遮蔽你的视野 —— 你必须将其屠戮殆尽！让他们品尝刀刃的刺痛，而非无辜者！

messages.msgid: A full body multilayered suit of skeletal plate armor.
translations: 一套覆盖全身的多层骨骼铠甲。

messages.msgid: You've taken so many hits to the head that your skull's gotten thicker.
translations: 你的头部受到了如此多的打击，以至于你的头骨变得更厚了。

messages.msgid: You'll protect your allies no matter the cost.
translations: 你会不惜一切代价保护你的盟友。

messages.msgid: You are holding this object really hard, so hard it cannot be removed from your hand unless you die.  Activate the unopenable grip perk again to be able to drop this object.
translations: 你死死攥住这件物品，除非身死，否则绝不脱手。再次激活“铁钳之握”技能即可松开。

messages.msgid: Oh, you aren't getting away with that.
